band_reason: Override HIGH→MEDIUM. The model's R=3 comes from blast_radius=2.34 at very low confidence (0.34). The composition overstates how far this reaches. The change adds one anchored exclude (^pnpm-lock\.yaml$) under check-yaml, a YAML-parse lint and not a security or access guard. gitleaks hooks are unchanged (safety card). merge() never modifies a hook that is already present (F2), so existing estate repos are untouched and only newly seeded repos receive the line. Reversibility is 0.89 and data_security 0.79; no dimension points to irreversible or security exposure. It is not LOW: this is shared estate provisioning infrastructure, and the new behavior has no automated test (F1).
setting finding: F1 (works-and-proven) · .github/scripts/pre-commit-suite-merge.py:140 · The new `exclude: ^pnpm-lock\.yaml$` extra line for check-yaml has no automated test. The stale-suite case in provision-public-repo.test.sh and new-repo.test.sh:469 only grep for `id: check-yaml`, so a revert or typo would pass every test. Fix: add an assertion in the stale-suite case that the merged output has the exclude directly under `- id: check-yaml`.
established:
  - F1 · .github/scripts/pre-commit-suite-merge.py:140 · The pnpm-lock exclude added to the check-yaml suite entry has no test, unlike biome-check's exclude which has a grep assertion. Removing or mistyping it would go unnoticed.
  - F2 · .github/scripts/pre-commit-suite-merge.py:314-315 · merge() treats an existing check-yaml as present and skips its extra lines, so the body's claims ("every repo the provisioner manages", and the margot-pr-reviewer "reports no change" proof) are not what the code does. Correct the body, or make the merge add extra lines to hooks that are already present, with a test.
  - F3 · .github/scripts/pre-commit-suite-merge.py:79 · The header at lines 79–88 lists the only reasons a hook gets extra lines. check-yaml's file-scoping exclude fits none of them, so the note is now wrong. Widen it to cover file-scoping carve-outs on any hook.
